criteria.description: CI=true npm test wall time within 10% of develop, median of five alternating runs
criteria.note: Re-measured on the LAN server at head ce14eebb6c72 (clean checkout, no later code change): five alternating runs, develop first, uptime beside each, the same docker invocation as scripts/remote-test/run.sh. Median branch 770 s vs develop 722 s = +6.6%, within the 10% limit. Recorded in this run's DoD file (lines 39-52). Superseded note: the cycle 1 figure task.278.qa.1:77 records five alternating runs with load average per run and a median of 743 s on the branch against 770 s on develop (-3.5%), measured with `CI=true npm run test:remote -- --run test`. The record does not name the measured commit M. The nearest candidates are 97b45a535 and 25325d21e446 (the cycle 1 review head). `finalise-delta.js docs-only --base 25325d21e446 --head HEAD --json` returns reason `code-changed` (exit 1), and so does `--base 97b45a535`. Cycle 2 changed code (the fixPathTarget normalise in ci-tree-equivalence.js and the fold's kind allow-list in qa-diminishing-returns.js), and the QA reports 2-4 carry the -3.5% figure forward as 'no hot path changed' without re-measuring. The figure no longer counts, so it needs a fresh median of five runs on the head, with load recorded.
